value.rationale: The natural physical decision is how many arrivals must finish before a finite experiment ends. Qualitative infinite-N rank advice misses an O(1) shift of about 2.076 completed particles at the reset-benefit boundary. The exact fixed-population/fixed-rank sign staircase constrains the possible choice regions for independently reset search teams. The offset is a motivated finite-size correction to a studied collective search objective and can change physical integer-rank decisions.
